record.field: Québec Safety Code, Building chapter (National Fire Code, 6.2.1.1 and NFPA 10)

A tag on the bracket of each extinguisher, not on the extinguisher itself, which is swapped out during maintenance. Each checkpoint of the round fills in the RBQ checklist; the register is printed from the readings. An extinguisher not read within the month creates an activity. The Building chapter exempts some small buildings (ss. 340 and 341): check whether it applies to yours.
Extinguisher 1 ; front lobby Extinguisher 2 ; 2nd floor hallway Extinguisher 3 ; mechanical room

Québec Safety Code, Building chapter (National Fire Code, 2.2.2.4)
A tag near each self-closing fire door. The morning round finds it closed or not; a round not done within its window creates an activity.
